job_description:
We're looking for a passionate Junior Software Engineer to join our growing team in San Francisco! This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or early-career developers with a Computer Science degree.

What You'll Do:
- Develop and maintain web applications using modern technologies
- Write clean, well-documented code following best practices
- Collaborate with senior engineers and learn from experienced mentors
- Participate in code reviews and team meetings
- Debug and fix issues in existing applications
- Contribute to technical documentation
- Work on both frontend and backend features

What We're Looking For:
- BS in Computer Science or related field (recent graduates welcome!)
- Strong foundation in programming fundamentals
- Familiarity with at least one programming language (Python, JavaScript, Java, etc.)
- Basic understanding of web development concepts
- Eagerness to learn and grow
- Good communication and teamwork skills
- Problem-solving mindset

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Git and version control
- Exposure to databases (SQL or NoSQL)
- Understanding of RESTful APIs
- Any personal projects or internship experience

We Offer:
- Competitive salary with annual reviews
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401k with company match
- Generous PTO and flexible work schedule
- Professional development budget
- Mentorship program
- Modern office in downtown San Francisco with hybrid work options
- Free lunch, snacks, and drinks
- Regular team events and activities
